usage: Protocol reference only. The front-end TypeScript parsers and caller-transport request orchestration reuse Node Comics code; upstream Kotlin/APK code is not executed or bundled.
scope: Public HTML name search for WebtoonScan; read-only madara_load_more content-search POST pagination for LHTranslation, Mangasushi, Manga Eclipse, Bun Manga and Monopoly Scan, verified against their live endpoints; static ungrouped and manga-scoped AJAX chapter lists; verified chapter-canonical/static-select, chapter-canonical/AJAX-select (including the repeated breadcrumb picker and fully server-populated holders) and catalog-canonical/static-select reader identities; contiguous image-N page slots. Other upstream Madara modules are not registered or claimed compatible.

files.purpose: Reference for MangaPage and MangaAjax chapter protocols, Madara HTML containers and image attributes; other chapter modes, view tracking and protected-page decryption are not implemented.
Reference for public HTML search URLs and pagination; RSS and post-ID recovery are not implemented.
